mergedPRs.title: fix(event-post-sync): cascade lineup add/remove on full event update
mergedPRs.author: feng-1m
mergedPRs.body:
## Root Cause

`ProductEventService.update()` published post-sync from a stale in-memory `entity`. The lineup/media operations (`batchOperate` / `doBatchOperateMedias`) write directly to the DB inside their own transactions but never refresh the in-memory object. As a result, `publishAsync(oldEntity, entity)` passed a `newEvent` whose `.event.lineups` still reflected the pre-update snapshot — so the post-sync change detector saw no lineup delta and dropped added/removed performers silently.

openPRs.author: feng-1m
openPRs.body:
## Problem

The Event→Post sync had **3 accreted publish paths** with inconsistent freshness guarantees:

1. **`withEventSync`** — used a closure-captured entity (stale after `batchOperate` lineup changes) → caused the #8376 lineup bug
2. **product-v2 strategy hooks** — called `triggerEventPostSync` directly, bypassing the unified path
3. **`update()` service method** — applied snapshot masking that hid tax-recalc price changes and missed products-added-to-sync-disabled events; duplicate-service
